name: bylaw
description: Review pull requests against your repository's own rules and the requirements they claim to implement.

interface.shortDescription: Review a PR against the repository's own rules and linked requirements.
interface.longDescription: bylaw reviews a pull request or a local branch against what the repository already wrote down: .editorconfig, linter configuration, CONTRIBUTING and agent instructions, and the acceptance criteria of the issues and specs the change implements. Every rule finding cites its source line, and findings are checked before they are posted. The Codex model does the reviewing, so no extra API key is needed.
defaultPrompt: Review the pull request for this branch with bylaw.
